visual_logic.subject_appearance: Solid black silhouette. Impossible proportions: a neck twice as long as the entire body and tail combined.
visual_logic.environment: Deep, 'Dark Organic Mud' substrate with tea-colored water.
visual_logic.backlight_strategy: Strong diagonal lighting to frame the incredible length of the stiff, rod-like neck.
visual_logic.facial_silhouette: Small head at the end of a long, straight neck; narrow snout.

pose: Neck extended diagonally toward the surface from the bottom, body anchored near a rock, illustrating its unique ambush-predator morphology.
negative_constraints: The neck must not bend like a snake; it should remain relatively rigid to reflect its unique vertebrae.
